# palette-slash

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-001 — A writer formats and inserts Markdown, GFM and MyST constructs from the palette](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-001.md) — When a writer edits a block in edit mode, the Studio SHALL offer an edition palette of buttons, in the GitHub Flavored Markdown and MyST modes with their constructs, that write Markdown formatting into the text in one undoable step, or leave the text unchanged and say why when the action cannot apply.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-002 — A writer chooses which palette buttons are offered](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-002.md) — When a writer works in a workspace, the Studio SHALL let the writer choose between a strict Markdown, a GitHub Flavored Markdown and a MyST set of palette buttons, keep the choice for the workspace, show only the buttons of the chosen set, start a workspace without a choice in the mode given by the settings, and let the writer reach the choice from the keyboard.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-005 — The palette stays in reach, appears softly and never closes the editor by accident](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-005.md) — While a writer edits a block, the Studio SHALL keep the edition palette visible next to the text box, also for a very tall text box and in a narrow pane, show it and its menus with a short fade unless the writer prefers reduced motion, and keep the editor open with the focus in the text when a palette button is pressed or a picker is opened, saving only when the writer leaves it.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-007 — A writer inserts links, images, figures, tables, colours and emoji through pickers](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-007.md) — When a writer asks for a link, an image, a figure, a table, a colour or an emoji from the palette, the Studio SHALL open a picker for it and write the matching safe Markdown at the selection, replacing the selection or the existing link, and leave the rest of the source of an existing figure untouched.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-013 — A writer picks labels, documents, citations and code languages from host lists, with feedback](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-013.md) — When a writer inserts a reference, a document link, a citation or a code block, the Studio SHALL offer the labels of the document, a file picker for documents, the keys of the bibliography files of the workspace, or exactly the languages the preview can highlight, write the matching role or fence, and answer every request for a list, a file or a conversion within a bounded time with the result or a reason the writer can read.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-015 — A writer runs any palette command from an accessible slash menu](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-015.md) — When a writer types a slash at the start of a line or after a space in a block text box, or in a table cell editor, the Studio SHALL open a menu of the commands of the palette for the current mode, narrow them as the writer types, run the chosen command from the keyboard or the mouse, and keep the menu visible next to the caret inside the pane and announced to assistive technology.
- [StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-018 — A writer pastes screenshots and rich text safely as Markdown](StRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-PALETTE-018.md) — When a writer pastes an image or rich text into a block text box, the Studio SHALL save an image as a file next to the document with a reference as a paragraph of its own, or replace the selection with the rich text converted to Markdown without scripts, styles, hidden content or unsafe addresses, in one undoable step saved with the other text of that editor.
